detail.longDescription: Adding the Kingbase PDO estension to a PHP 5.6 Docker image is failing. PHP refuses to load pdo_kdb.so with an undefined symbol error. The extension has been copied into the PHP extension directory and configured in php.ini , but it still won't load. Environment PHP 5.6 NTS (Non Thread Safe) Extension directory no-debug-non-zts-20131226 Docker image build KingbaseES PDO driver pdo_kdb.so Error message: PHP Warning: PHP Start: Unable to load dynamic library '/user/local/lib/php/extension/no-debug-non-zts-20131226/pdo_kdb. so' undefined symbol: file_globals_id in Unkown on line 0 Is undefined symbol: file_global_id related to a thread-safety mismatch? Since the PHP build is NTS, is an NTS version of pdo_kdb.so specifically required? Has anyone managed to get the Kingbase PDO estension working in a PHP 5.6 Docker image?
